title: Substitution for Member at Shan State Investment Committee
text:
The Republic of the Union of Myanmar
Myan a I vestment Co mission
Notification No. 14 / 2020
The 4th Waning of Second Waso, 1382 ME
(7 August 2020)
Substitution for Member at Shan State Investment Committee
U Nay Lin, Secretary of the Shan State Government has been appointed as the
member of Shan State Investment Committee which was formed by the Notification
No.(54/2017) of Myanmar Investment Commission.
(Thaung Tun)
Chairman
